title: Hello Rectangle
description: Draw rectangles two ways (by diagonal, by two edges), change the frame's shape, then read the status and available-keys boxes to keep learning on your own.

bubble.title: Welcome to NibGlider
bubble.body: The mouse steers the cursor, but keys do the clicking. This tour points at the controls you will need.

bubble.title: Watch it draw first
bubble.body: Press Watch demo: the program steers the cursor itself and presses I twice to draw a rectangle, live on the canvas.

demo.title: First corner
demo.body: Steering to the first corner of the diagonal.

demo.title: Second corner
demo.body: The I key starts Rect by Diagonal. Now steering to the opposite corner.

demo.title: Done
demo.body: The second I press deposits the rectangle, exactly as your own key presses would.

bubble.title: Your turn: press I
bubble.body: Steer the mouse where you want the first corner, then press the I key to start Rect by Diagonal — the same key the demo pressed.

bubble.title: Place the opposite corner
bubble.body: Steer to the opposite corner and press I again to deposit your rectangle.

bubble.title: Watch: rectangle by two edges
bubble.body: Press Watch demo: the program steers the cursor itself and presses U twice to draw a rectangle from two edges, live on the canvas.

demo.title: Second edge
demo.body: The U key starts Rect by Two Edges. Now steering to the opposite edge.

demo.title: Done
demo.body: The second U press deposits the rectangle, exactly as your own key presses would.

bubble.title: Your turn: press U
bubble.body: Steer the mouse where you want to start, then press the U key to start Rect by Two Edges — the same key the demo pressed.

bubble.title: Place the second edge
bubble.body: Steer to the second edge and press U again to deposit your rectangle.

bubble.title: Change the frame's shape
bubble.body: Here's where to change the shape that the rectangle frame draws. Hover over this control to see the shapes — circles, polygons, and more.

bubble.title: The status box
bubble.body: The status box tells you what is happening and what you can do next.

bubble.title: The available keys box
bubble.body: The available keys box tells you what keys you can use. You can learn how to use many keys on your own from these two boxes.
